stemMd: A report is accepted if it is signed and complete. The report was not accepted. Which statement must be true?

options.label: D
options.textMd: It was unsigned or incomplete, or both.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It was both unsigned and incomplete.

explanationMd: The rule is signed-and-complete implies accepted. Its contrapositive says not accepted implies not(signed-and-complete). By De Morgan’s law, that is unsigned or incomplete. The inclusive “or” also allows both deficiencies.

distractorRationale.e: Failure of a conjunction requires at least one missing part, not necessarily both.
distractorRationale.c: The premises do not identify which required part failed.
distractorRationale.b: This is possible but not forced over the other possibilities.
distractorRationale.a: That would trigger acceptance by the rule.
